paper_title: Earth as a transducer for axion dark-matter detection
notes: Search for axion-photon coupling via oscillating terrestrial magnetic field in SuperMAG magnetometer network data. Mass range 2e-18 to 7e-17 eV. Strongest 95%-credible limit g_agamma <= 6.5e-11 GeV^-1 for ~3-4e-17 eV, comparable to CAST. Only Fig.1 exclusion curve available (no data table); data points approximated from text statements and figure - limit improves with increasing mass. rho_dm = 0.3 GeV/cm^3 assumed.
